1x1.heic.source: homescoop: magick -size 1x1 xc:'#c83214' p1.png && heif-enc -q 90 p1.png -o 1x1.heic (libheif 1.23.6, x265)

odd-1023x769.heic.source: homescoop: magick -size 1023x769 gradient:red-blue odd.png && heif-enc -q 80 odd.png -o odd-1023x769.heic

rot90-17x9.heic.what: 17x9 blue with a red 8x4 block at the top left, lossless RGB HEVC, irot 270 (displayed rotated 90 degrees clockwise: 9x17, red block top right)
rot90-17x9.heic.source: homescoop: magick -size 17x9 xc:blue -fill red -draw 'rectangle 0,0 7,3' PNG24:o.png && heif-enc -L --rotate-cw 90 o.png -o rot90-17x9.heic
